comments.text:
I’m sorry, but that final one was pretty insulting.
The entire twist of links awakening is the sheer fact that for link to leave the island and go home would mean that he would have to essentially kill everybody on that island.

It doesn’t matter if in the end it’s shown that it was the right thing to do. It’s still an extremely dark thing.

The whole point of that three second end of the game scene that you get for being able to beat the game without dying.
Is supposed to show that the only one on that island that you could consider to be link‘s friend managed to survive the extinction of the island.


Also, the idea in Pokémon.
 that if you caught all 150, your reward would be another Pokémon?
 or a master ball which you wouldn’t need if you’ve already caught every Pokémon.
I actually feel that would be more insulting.
At least, with the thing you get is basically a certificate that you could use as physical bragging rights for your friends at recess.

Doesn’t mean much now for adults, but for little kids which the game was originally made for that was probably a really big deal.
